stories.title: Versioned schema catalog

stories.title: Independently replayable research harness

stories.title: Risk, prior art and novelty register

No generic “first” or “better compression” claim without experiment.
Negative results are retained.

stories.remaining: Independent novelty assessment; no priority or superiority claim is made.

stories.title: Purpose-scoped information obligations

criteria.text: Schema expresses mandatory fields, exact fields, allowable approximation and unanswered/unknown distinctions.
Every required field maps to immutable source anchors.

stories.remaining: Domain-owner review of purpose and preservation obligations.

Each mapped obligation references reviewed IR node IDs, source hash, omission permission and independent-review signature.
Deferred/unsupported semantics remain UNKNOWN.
Any mismatch REFUSEs use.

stories.title: Omission and residual audit

Clinical case distinguishes symptoms from diagnosis; legal case protects role bindings; video case protects text/timing.
Independent reviewers score adversarial examples.
Failing examples remain visible.

stories.title: SAT/UNSAT/UNKNOWN semantics

criteria.text: SAT only if every modeled obligation is satisfied.
UNSAT includes minimal available counterexample and violated clause.
Missing data or exhausted search returns UNKNOWN.
Finite SAT never emits QualityRag ADMIT or can_generate=true by itself.

stories.title: Executable finite ACTIVATE/VERIFY/FALLBACK

criteria.text: Typed interpreter implements bounded, sandboxed operators with no `eval`/dynamic imports.
Uses actual transformed output, not merely stated `preserves` lists.

VERIFY compares actual output to all anchored obligations; fallback must independently satisfy authorization, compatibility, preservation and resource limits. At most one fallback attempt; failure terminates in REFUSE without releasing output.
Replay emits deterministic execution trace.

stories.remaining: Merged review; the interpreter is finite and deliberately cannot certify domain truth.
